stem: M is the centre of a circle, and A, B and C are points on the circle with C on the major arc AB. The inscribed angle $\angle ACB = (x + {=p})^\circ$ and the central angle $\angle AMB = (3x - {=q})^\circ$, both subtended by the arc AB. Find the measure of $\angle MAB$ in degrees.
solution: The inscribed angle is half the central angle subtended by the same arc, so $3x - {=q} = 2(x + {=p})$.
The inscribed angle is $x + {=p} = {=ins}^\circ$, so the central angle $\angle AMB = 2 \times {=ins} = {=cen}^\circ$.
MA = MB (radii), so the base angles of triangle MAB are equal.
notes: Twist on book drill 5 (isosceles triangle MAB with central angle double the inscribed angle), with the angles given as algebraic expressions. Stem is text-only; C on the major arc is stated so the central angle is 2 x inscribed. Inscribed angle is always below 80, so the answer is a positive whole number.
